value.rationale: The six-pointed genus-zero compactification is a canonical moduli object whose normal-crossings boundary has 105 one-dimensional and 105 zero-dimensional strata. The exact formal incidence cokernel exposes nine independent parity defects inaccessible from the rational rank, measuring integral failure of saturation of the three-point curve sums. This is a complete natural boundary incidence invariant, not an arbitrary parameter slice; the claim is deliberately separated from Chow groups and ordinary cellular homology.
